query: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN price > (SELECT AVG(price) FROM products WHERE category = 'electronics' AND ref_id IN (SELECT ref_id FROM categories WHERE cat_nm = 'Computers & Accessories' AND cat_lvl = 1)) THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_above_avg FROM products WHERE category = 'electronics' AND ref_id IN (SELECT ref_id FROM categories WHERE cat_nm = 'Computers & Accessories' AND cat_lvl = 1)
